steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Begin the game. Pick whichever interview answer suits your preferred stats. Collect the two Medicinal Herbs in the desert if useful.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Story.

steps.label: Story day
steps.text: Follow the main objective. No separate free-time activity is scheduled; continue until the game advances the date.

steps.label: Story day
steps.text: Follow the main objective. No separate free-time activity is scheduled; continue until the game advances the date.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Complete the Northern Border Fort sequence.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: At the outdoor camp afterwards, collect the Gold Beetle near the tree behind Strohl before continuing. This camp is a one-time visit. If you have already passed it, keep playing: there are other beetles and a later run available.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Progress through Nord Mines. Save at the Magla Hollow when available.

steps.label: Optional
steps.text: The sleeping dragon is a reward fight, not a platinum requirement. Challenge it only with enough healing and MP. Mage must reach rank 2 to learn Blizz; simply switching to Mage does not provide it. Skip the fight if your resources are poor. The original triple-Mage suggestion does not guarantee an easy win on Normal.

steps.label: MP tip
steps.text: With the protagonist channeling Mage, eligible field stuns and defeats restore 1 MP to the party. Check your MP after an encounter before committing to a recovery loop.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Story.

steps.label: Story day
steps.text: Follow the main objective. No separate free-time activity is scheduled; continue until the game advances the date.

steps.label: Story day
steps.text: Follow the main objective. No separate free-time activity is scheduled; continue until the game advances the date.

steps.label: Story day
steps.text: Follow the main objective. No separate free-time activity is scheduled; continue until the game advances the date.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Follow the story and the initial Maria event. Idlesday falls on dates ending in 0 or 5; check shop discounts when shopping is available.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Follow the required story sequence. Accept More's Foreword and Prologue task when available. Start training Healer toward rank 10 on a party member. You do not need preorder items.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Use equipment that suits your current Archetype. The mine's optional reward is not assumed here.

steps.label: Habit
steps.text: Use different Synthesis skills as they become available and keep track of which ones you have used. Enter squad battles with an advantage often; instant field defeats do not count as squad ambushes. Aim for unscathed wins where practical. Talk to Gallica and sword-surf around town regularly so those counters do not all become endgame chores.

steps.label: Today's plan
steps.text: Finish the free errands first, use the afternoon bench for Wisdom, then cook at the inn at night. Walking between districts, shopping and accepting these requests do not use the main activity slot.

steps.label: Free errand · Sunshade Row
steps.text: Outside the Hushed Honeybee Inn, speak to the Mustari Man and accept Pagan's Dilemma.

steps.label: Free errand · informant
steps.text: Still OUTSIDE the inn, speak to the winged Knowledgeable Man by the stairs. His name is Ardea. Buy Grand Cathedral Status now so he will be available inside the inn tonight. He is not beside the Young Nidia on Sunlumeo Street.

steps.label: Free errand · Sunshade Row
steps.text: Give one Medicinal Herb to the Man in Pain in the alley near More's Phantom. You receive a Hero's Incense.

steps.label: Free errand · Sunlumeo Street
steps.text: Speak to the Young Nidia at the southeastern quest marker and accept Help the Hushed Honeybee. If you already accepted it, continue with the other errands; you do not need to accept it again.

steps.label: Free errand · church
steps.text: Enter St. Fermis Church on the northwest side of Sunlumeo Street. Speak to the Sanctor, choose to buy, and purchase Breath of Fresh Air for 500 reeve. The quest medicine is available even if you cannot yet purify equipment.

steps.label: Free hand-in · Sunshade Row
steps.text: Return to the Mustari Man outside the inn and give him the medicine. Make sure you receive the reward and Tolerance increase.

steps.label: Free collection · Sunshade Row
steps.text: Check behind the stairs near the armour shop, then go inside Comfort Concoctions and inspect the spice sack for a second Gold Beetle. Follow the prompt to put your hand in the sack. A beetle you can see but cannot reach elsewhere in the shop is a separate, later pickup.

steps.label: Free collection · Recruitment Centre
steps.text: Go to the Regalith Grand Cathedral outdoor square in Grand Trad. Find the Recruitment Centre on the left-hand side of this area's map, near the Masked Shopkeeper. Inside, face the bulletin board opposite the counter. Enter the hallway to its left, then turn around and inspect the glowing corner near the hallway entrance for the Gold Beetle. These three town pickups do not spend the afternoon.

steps.label: Free errand · market
steps.text: In the northeast of the Regalith Grand Cathedral market, speak to the Herb-Seller and ask about Redgrass. His refusal makes the relevant information available from Ardea. You will return to buy the ingredient tonight.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Return to Sunlumeo Street. Sit on the bench near the magic shop, marked with the Wisdom activity icon, and observe the city. This ends the afternoon. Do it only after the errands above.

steps.label: Night · free errand
steps.text: Go INSIDE the Hushed Honeybee Inn on Sunshade Row. Find Ardea, the Knowledgeable Man, and buy Secret of the Redgrass Shop for 600 reeve. If it is missing from his list, speak to the market's Herb-Seller about Redgrass first, then return here before cooking.

steps.label: Night · free shopping
steps.text: Go to the food stalls in the Regalith Grand Cathedral market area. At the Herb-Seller, ask “Do you know Grius?” to unlock Redgrass. Buy enough Redgrass, Bidou Meat from the butcher, and Pristine Clearwater from the water seller for four inn meals; check what you already own before buying. The water seller is in the northwest market, the butcher in the middle, and the herb seller toward the northeast.

steps.label: Night · optional free errands
steps.text: Enter shops to add them to your map. You can appraise the Rusted Accessory from Pagan's Dilemma at a shop that offers appraisal; this identifies the item and is different from church purification. Visit Gloamhall while it is open at night. The meat-skewer eating contest at the market also fits here without using the cooking slot.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Return to Fabienne behind the inn counter. Ask to make Redgrass-Roasted Bidou and choose “Let's stick to the recipe.” This is tonight's activity and gives Tolerance.

steps.label: Before moving on
steps.text: Pagan's Dilemma should be reported, and Help the Hushed Honeybee should be ready to report tomorrow. Keep the remaining meal ingredients. You do not need Wisdom rank 2 before tonight's cooking; tomorrow's quest reward helps reach it.

steps.label: Free hand-in · Sunlumeo Street
steps.text: Return to the Young Nidia who gave you Help the Hushed Honeybee. Claim the reward. Cooking last night alone did not finish the hand-in.

steps.label: Checkpoint
steps.text: Open your Royal Virtues display and check Wisdom is rank 2, Informed. Yesterday's bench and today's request reward are the planned gains. If it is still rank 1, check both were completed before spending another time slot.

steps.label: Free request · Sunlumeo Street
steps.text: Speak to the Igniter Merchantess outside Lycaon Magic Association. With Wisdom 2, choose “At least describe the job” and accept A Bullish Embargo. She introduces herself as Brigitta; Belega Corridor should now be a destination.

steps.label: Optional free preparation
steps.text: At St. Fermis Church, use Purify on eligible equipment if the upgrade is useful and you have the required water and money. This is not necessary for every item. Appraise unidentified loot at the appropriate shop instead.

steps.label: Free preparation · Sunshade Row
steps.text: After accepting A Bullish Embargo, find Ardea outside the Hushed Honeybee Inn and buy Ox Demon of Belega Corridor for 250 reeve. Read it before departing. Active Mage or Healer Archetypes provoke the Goborns and the boss; equip other Archetypes for those fights. Inherited spells on those other Archetypes remain usable. Do not force Healer training here just to follow a checklist.

steps.label: Afternoon · departure uses time
steps.text: Leave by the main gate at the south end of Sunlumeo Street and select Belega Corridor. Finish shopping first. The original 80,000-reeve target is optional, not an entry fee or trophy condition.

steps.label: Dungeon
steps.text: Work through Belega Corridor and defeat the request target. Before leaving, look for the Gold Beetle reached through a crawl passage off a large room on a lower floor. Check walls with Fae Sight if the passage is hard to see.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: The dungeon uses today's outing; there is no separate evening activity. Return to town when ready. Tomorrow you will report to Brigitta, so keep the request reward pending until that scheduled event.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Meet Brigitta outside Lycaon Magic Association on Sunlumeo Street. Report A Bullish Embargo and complete the introductory bond event. Check Brigitta is now rank 1; this unlocks the Merchant study path.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Go to Fabienne at the Hushed Honeybee Inn in Sunshade Row. Make Redgrass-Roasted Bidou using another set of ingredients and stick to the recipe again. This meal is for Tolerance, even though the Young Nidia's quest is already finished.

steps.label: Free preparation
steps.text: Shop before leaving; today is an Idlesday sale. Buy useful healing and available MP restoratives without spending your entire reeve or MAG reserve.

steps.label: Afternoon · dungeon outing
steps.text: Enter the Grand Cathedral through its Mausoleum entrance and work toward completing the main objective today. Keep a separate save before entering.

steps.label: Side request during the visit
steps.text: Speak to Catherina near the Mausoleum entrance to accept A Friend in Need. Find the key and unlock the room holding the captives. Let the rescue scene finish; it completes the request and unlocks Catherina rank 1. Check the quest log and follower rank before proceeding. Locked sections associated with other requests can wait.

steps.label: Training during the dungeon
steps.text: Have a party member study Healer in Akademeia and earn Archetype experience toward rank 10, using it where the team can fight safely. Character level 10 is not the same as Healer rank 10. A-EXP items can fill a small shortfall.

steps.label: Free More hand-in
steps.text: When Healer reaches rank 10, enter Akademeia through More's Phantom and speak to More about his completed task. Confirm More rank 2 and accept the next task. Aim to finish this today; 19 June is the next planned dungeon opportunity. His hand-in does not consume a town activity slot.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon. The schedule assumes a one-visit clear. Use the protagonist's Mage field recovery where safe, save at Magla Hollows and preserve an earlier save if resources force a second visit. Do not force an unwinnable battle solely to match the date.

steps.label: Free errand · Grand Trad, Regalith Grand Cathedral area
steps.text: Open the town map and select Recruitment Centre if it is already available for fast travel. Otherwise, travel to the Regalith Grand Cathedral outdoor square; the Recruitment Centre entrance is on the left-hand side of this area's map, near the Masked Shopkeeper. Go inside and speak to the Recruiter Dispatcher behind the counter. Accept Man's Not-So Best Friend (target: Maneater Manjula). Accepting the bounty does not spend the afternoon; the desert visit is scheduled for 19 June.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Strohl through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 2.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Brigitta through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 2.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Hulkenberg through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 2.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Visit Fabienne at the Hushed Honeybee Inn in Sunshade Row. Cook Redgrass-Roasted Bidou and stick to the recipe.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Strohl through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 3.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Brigitta through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 3.

steps.label: Afternoon · dungeon outing
steps.text: After accepting the Manjula bounty, leave through Grand Trad's main gate on Sunlumeo Street and choose Tradia Desert. Defeat Manjula and collect the area's Gold Beetle before returning. Ignore the much stronger optional roaming enemy if it appears on a revisit.

steps.label: Checkpoint before leaving
steps.text: Healer rank 10, More's first task reported, More rank 2. Spend saved A-EXP items if needed; do not postpone the hand-in until a later stat check.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon.

steps.label: Free hand-in
steps.text: Return to the bounty desk in Grand Trad's Recruitment Centre and claim the Manjula reward. Optional discounted shopping and MAG exchange; keep a reserve for Archetypes.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Speak to the Activist Woman across from Comfort Concoctions in Sunshade Row. Donate 250 reeve and agree to spend time with her for Eloquence.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Brigitta through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 4.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Return to the Activist Woman across from Comfort Concoctions in Sunshade Row. Donate another 250 reeve and spend time with her for Eloquence.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Speak to Fabienne at the Hushed Honeybee and cook Redgrass-Roasted Bidou; stick to the recipe. Check Tolerance 2 before the next Maria event. If short, check Pagan's Dilemma was reported and all four planned meals were completed correctly.

steps.label: Story day
steps.text: Follow the main objective. No separate free-time activity is scheduled; continue until the game advances the date.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Follow the story and accept the requests introduced during it.

steps.label: First runner visit
steps.text: Explore the rooms and locate the bookshelf, kitchen/cooking table, pantry and toilet. The runner is your travelling base. Reading or spending time with someone is a main activity; checking the pantry is a free errand.

steps.label: Free routine
steps.text: Inspect the cooking table for recipes and check the pantry on each available day, including days parked in town. Keep at least five Gauntlet Shrooms for later recipes rather than selling them.

steps.label: Reading instructions
steps.text: Use the lounge bookshelf, choose the named book and complete one session. A session spends the current travel period. “First”, “second” and “finish” below refer to separate sessions, not three readings to do at once.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Read Pride and Persuasion, first session. Choose “To gain the upper hand.”

steps.label: Night · free errand
steps.text: When camped, inspect the campfire for an ingredient before choosing the main activity.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Spend the evening on Hulkenberg's Imagination conversation, not a different activity. “It's cool” is a suitable reply; check that the activity awards Imagination.

steps.label: Routine from now on
steps.text: Take the free campfire ingredient on nights spent camping. Use the toilet on accessible Idlesdays for Luck. These free errands are separate from the day's main activity.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Read Pride and Persuasion, second session; choose “Scare them.” Collect the automatic drawing during the journey.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Collect the free campfire ingredient first, then spend the evening on Strohl's Imagination conversation. “They had no allies” is a suitable reply.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: These two evening conversations and More's first hand-in are part of the original schedule's early Imagination assumptions.

steps.label: Story day
steps.text: Follow the story and required combat. During today's story conversations, you automatically receive a side quest from Neuras called Providing a Spark. If it is not in your quest log yet, continue the story; you do not need to find a separate quest giver. Leave this quest pending for the Komero visit scheduled later in the guide. There is no extra errand to complete for it today.

steps.label: Free collection · Martira
steps.text: Enter Visca Alba Tavern and inspect the fireplace for a Gold Beetle.

steps.label: Free collection · Visca Alba Tavern
steps.text: In your guest room, inspect the desk/pitcher beside your bed and choose to drink the water for another possible beetle. The pitcher reward is random; retry on later visits if it does not appear, and record it only once.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Follow the main investigation and story.

steps.label: Free errands · Martira
steps.text: Check the weapon/armour sale. In Thoroughfare Square, speak to the Gloomy Youth in the middle of the square and accept Hatching a Plan. Then speak to the Recruiter Dispatcher outside in the same square and accept The New King of the Imps, the Goborn King bounty. Accepting these requests does not use time; today's remaining activities are in town.

steps.label: Free hand-in · Grand Trad
steps.text: Open the map and switch to town-to-town travel, then teleport to Grand Trad. Go to Sunshade Row → Hushed Honeybee Inn and speak to Fabienne behind the counter. This hands over the drawing from your journey and completes Promising Returns. If your quest log already marks it complete, skip this hand-in. Teleporting between towns and this hand-in do not use the afternoon.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Stay at the Hushed Honeybee Inn. After the hand-in, speak to Fabienne about Maria and choose “I want to make Maria smile.” You need Tolerance rank 2 (Open-Minded). Accept the time-consuming outing and finish at Maria bond rank 2. Completing Promising Returns alone does not complete this bond event.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Return to Martira → Thoroughfare Square. Speak to the Spirited Youth at the wooden ledge on the northwestern side of the square. Save, then pay 250 reeve for your first cliff jump. Receiving a Foreign Coin confirms success; gaining Courage alone does not. If you fail, reload the save before retrying. After a successful jump, he offers a thinner rope on your next visit. Stop after tonight's success; the guide schedules the other visits later.

steps.label: Before travel
steps.text: Restock during the Idlesday sale and use the toilet if accessible.

steps.label: Afternoon · set the route
steps.text: On the runner's round table map, choose Imp's Den for the Goborn King bounty. Confirm the destination before departure.

steps.label: While travelling
steps.text: Speak to Hulkenberg and choose her bond event, reaching rank 3. This uses the travel activity, not an additional day.

steps.label: At the destination
steps.text: Clear the Goborn King bounty and collect the Gold Beetle before returning.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Return; no additional free activity.

steps.label: Free hand-in · Martira
steps.text: Go to Thoroughfare Square and speak to the Recruiter Dispatcher outdoors. Report The New King of the Imps to claim the Goborn King bounty reward.

steps.label: Free requests · Grand Trad
steps.text: After reporting the bounty, teleport to Grand Trad. On Sunlumeo Street, speak to the Resentful Noble just south of Lycaon Magic Association, the igniter shop, and accept A Haunted Heirloom. Then go through the Regalith Grand Cathedral area to Catacombs Entrance. Speak to the Nervous Soldier outside the Mausoleum and accept Skullduggery. Stop at the entrance; today's afternoon is reserved for Maria. Both dungeon objectives are scheduled together for 11 July.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Go to Grand Trad → Sunshade Row and find Maria near the Hushed Honeybee Inn using the Followers menu. This rank 3 event needs rank 2 completed at least two in-game days earlier; the schedule assumes you did that on 29 June. Check for her rank-up handshake, then take the event. If it is unavailable, leave this step unchecked and check the earlier bond before choosing an activity that spends time.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Return to the Spirited Youth at the wooden ledge on the northwestern side of Martira's Thoroughfare Square. Save before starting. After your first successful jump, he offers a thinner rope for 375 reeve; this second challenge needs Courage rank 2. Accept it and check for a Foreign Coin reward to confirm success. The jump can look the same as before; the fee and reward identify your progress. If he still asks for 250 reeve, you have not cleared the first challenge on this save. If you fail despite meeting the Courage requirement, reload before retrying.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Depart for the Giant Sandworm's Nest. Read New World Travel Diary, first session. Follow the required travel encounter; check Catherina reaches rank 2. Receive the drawing en route.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Read New World Travel Diary, second session; choose the pavilion answer.

steps.label: Checkpoint
steps.text: The source expects Imagination 2 here. If you are still rank 1, do not restart or spend an extra day: the third reading and More hand-in on 06 July provide another buffer before the request pickup on 07 July.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Complete the timed story dungeon. Explore for loot while watching the timer; the schedule does not require fighting every enemy.

steps.label: Story day
steps.text: Follow the main objective. No separate free-time activity is scheduled; continue until the game advances the date.

steps.label: Free errands · Martira
steps.text: Speak to the Recruiter Dispatcher outdoors in Thoroughfare Square and accept The Man-Eater in the Mine, the Alpha Rockworm bounty. Inspect the runner kitchen for new recipes and use the pantry/toilet when available.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Return to Maria at the Hushed Honeybee Inn and complete her rank 4 bond event. Check the reward includes Speed Cooking. From tomorrow, cooking can be done before the main travelling activity without consuming that period. Until this unlock, do not combine cooking with reading as if both were free.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Give the Stairstone Market speech; choose the answer promoting local delicacies. Check Eloquence 2 for the upcoming Heismay bond. The two June Eloquence activities matter here.

steps.label: Change
steps.text: A Dagger, a Ring, and a Rake is deliberately picked up on 07 July, after another reading session, so this plan does not depend on reaching Imagination 2 on 02 July.

steps.label: Before departure
steps.text: Confirm Hatching a Plan, Providing a Spark and the Alpha Rockworm Valmo bounty are active. Check Maria rank 4 and Speed Cooking. For today's runner meal, hold one Bidou Meat, one Pristine Clearwater and one Redgrass. The four June inn meals used their own ingredients. Buy any shortfall at Grand Trad's Regalith Grand Cathedral market: butcher, water seller and the Herb-Seller whose stock you unlocked in June.

steps.label: Afternoon · route
steps.text: Use the runner map to set a journey through Komero to Man-Eater's Grotto. Include Komero as the village stop; going straight to the dungeon would miss today's errands.

steps.label: While travelling
steps.text: At the kitchen, cook Redgrass-Roasted Bidou first. Then use the bookshelf to finish New World Travel Diary, choosing “Sounds pretty.” The reading spends the travel period; Speed Cooking is what allows the meal beforehand.

steps.label: At Komero
steps.text: Watch the automatic arrival event; it completes Providing a Spark and unlocks Neuras' bond and Gunner. Check that Relic Search: Inventor's Bequest has appeared in your log; its first relic is in today's Man-Eater's Grotto. In the shop's Key Items category, buy the Practical Pigeon Parcel for Hatching a Plan. Check that you have at least two Orgo Sugar in total for this month's bread and roast, counting any starter sugar you still own; buy the shortfall before continuing to the dungeon.

steps.label: At the dungeon entrance · free
steps.text: Enter Akademeia, study Gunner on an eligible party member and speak to More to turn in Chapter One, reaching More rank 3. Accept Chapter Two and study Merchant on a party member; it must reach rank 15 for the next task.

steps.label: Dungeon
steps.text: Defeat Alpha Rockworm Valmo, find the Screwed-Up Mineral relic and collect the Gold Beetle before leaving. Keep the relic for Neuras. If you have unlocked Steal, use it successfully in a squad battle once.

steps.label: Return
steps.text: Head back to town after completing the objectives. There is no extra free night activity.

steps.label: If Speed Cooking is missing
steps.text: Finish the scheduled book today and postpone the dish until a later travelling slot after Maria rank 4. Do not replace today's reading with time-consuming cooking.

steps.label: Free hand-ins · Martira
steps.text: In Thoroughfare Square, return the Practical Pigeon Parcel to the Gloomy Youth in the middle of the square to complete Hatching a Plan. Speak to the Recruiter Dispatcher outdoors in the same square to claim the Alpha Rockworm bounty reward. With Imagination 2, accept A Dagger, a Ring, and a Rake from the Pompous Man here. Check that the Abandoned Tomb is on your map before the 13 July trip.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Maria through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 5.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Neuras in the runner's Engine Room and give him the Screwed-Up Mineral. Complete the relic/bond event, reaching rank 2, and accept Relic Search: Dregs of Destiny. Finding the relic and reporting it are separate steps.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: If Imagination is still below 2, report any unclaimed More tasks first. A missing book completion or More hand-in needs correcting before the Tomb trip; do not travel there without the request.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Clear the Castle Waterways objective. Train Merchant to rank 15 on a party member and report More's Chapter Two task for rank 4. Accept the 15-Archetype task.

steps.label: During the dungeon
steps.text: Pick up the Giant Worm Meat from the blue item pickup in Kriegante Castle's Old Waterway. Keep one for cooking on the next story journey.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Steal useful items from mimics if your party supports it. The strong enemy in the stealth section is optional; avoiding it is valid.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon.

steps.label: Free request · Martira
steps.text: Go to Thoroughfare Square → Visca Alba Tavern. Speak to the Classy Woman inside, near the door to the guest room, and accept The Queen of Cuisine: Heart. You will cook the requested Benevolent Bread on the next long trip; keep one serving to return to her.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Speak to Bardon in Martira's Thoroughfare Square to begin his follower bond, rank 1. Study Commander if useful. Check your total of different studied Archetypes; after 15 distinct types across the party, report More's next task for rank 5. A follower unlock without studying the type does not count as a study.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Go to the speech podium in Martira's Stairstone Market. Check that Roger is the opponent and take the debate. Choose “Taxes benefit us all.” Record a win, not merely a speech. Save before the event if you want the option to retry.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Hulkenberg through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 4.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Heismay through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 2; requires Eloquence 2. If short, raise Eloquence instead and move this bond to the next available evening, keeping the debate dates intact.

steps.label: Before departure
steps.text: Check both Skullduggery and A Haunted Heirloom are in your quest log.

steps.label: Afternoon · dungeon outing
steps.text: Re-enter Grand Trad's Mausoleum/Catacombs. In the newly opened side section, fight Malmorta skeletons and coffin encounters for eight Mortaskulls; these are enemy rewards, not eight floor pickups. Defeat the request boss and finish its scene to receive the Black Jewel Necklace for the separate request.

steps.label: Before ending the outing
steps.text: Check you have both the eight Mortaskulls and the Black Jewel Necklace. Return to Catacombs Entrance and give the Mortaskulls to the Nervous Soldier to complete Skullduggery, then return to town. Keep the necklace for tomorrow's hand-in.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon.

steps.label: Free hand-in · Grand Trad
steps.text: On Sunlumeo Street, give the Black Jewel Necklace to the Resentful Noble just south of the igniter shop to complete A Haunted Heirloom. Skullduggery should be complete from yesterday; if it is still active, return to the Nervous Soldier at Catacombs Entrance and hand in the eight Mortaskulls before today's bond event.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Heismay through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 3.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Debate Lina at Stairstone Market. Choose “What are your policies?” Record the win.

steps.label: Free shopping · Martira
steps.text: Top up to these inventory totals. Count ingredients you already own; you do not need to buy the full amount again.
items: Cattleracket Road: accept the Kind Old Woman's vegetables if you have not collected them. At the Greengrocer Girl's stall, top up to 5 Rockbeans and 5 Fragrant Spice.
Stairstone Market → Fresh-Picked Meats: top up to 4 Mora Coney Meat and 2 Bidou Meat.
Thoroughfare Square → Opisth the Water Trader: top up to 3 Mellow Milk and 2 Pristine Clearwater.
Keep 2 Orgo Sugar from the earlier Komero visit: one for today's bread and one for 17 July.
Grand Trad → Regalith Grand Cathedral market: buy enough Redgrass from the Herb-Seller to hold 4.
This shopping covers several upcoming meals. The extra 2 Rockbeans, 3 Fragrant Spice and 3 Redgrass are for later recipes; keep them until the guide asks for them.

steps.label: Before departure · today's cooking
steps.text: Your first dish is Benevolent Bread, for The Queen of Cuisine: Heart request.
items: Check that you have 1 Fragrant Spice, 1 Mellow Milk and 1 Orgo Sugar. You do not need a moth or a bee for this dish.
You will cook after setting off in the next step. Save one finished serving for the Classy Woman in Martira on 15 July.
Cooking before another activity relies on Maria's rank-4 ability, Speed Cooking. If it is not unlocked, skip the cooking steps until it is; keep the scheduled bond and reading activities.

steps.label: Afternoon · travel, cook, then bond
steps.text: Set the runner's destination to Abandoned Tomb and begin the journey.
items: In the runner's kitchen, inspect the stove to collect any new recipes. Cook Benevolent Bread: 1 Fragrant Spice + 1 Mellow Milk + 1 Orgo Sugar.
Keep one serving in your inventory for the request. If you lack an ingredient, leave the recipe unfinished and continue with Strohl; the request has no deadline.
Then take Strohl's runner bond event, finishing at rank 4.

steps.label: Night · cook, then bond
steps.text: Check the glowing pickup beside the campfire before using the kitchen.
items: Cook Magical Bread if you have 2 Mora Coney Meat, 2 Rockbeans and 1 Dreameater Moth.
The campfire pickup is random. If you have no moth, keep the meat and beans, note that Magical Bread is still unfinished, and skip cooking tonight.
Then take Hulkenberg's runner bond event, finishing at rank 5. Speed Cooking allows one free cooking session in the afternoon and one at night, when the kitchen is available.

steps.label: Afternoon · cooking first
steps.text: Cook Invincible Noodles in the runner's kitchen if you have all three ingredients.
items: Ingredients: 1 Fragrant Spice + 2 Bidou Meat + 1 Lumibee.
If you have no Lumibee, keep the other ingredients and leave this recipe unfinished. Continue with today's reading and dungeon; you can cook the noodles on a later trip.

steps.label: Afternoon · main activity
steps.text: Finish Pride and Persuasion; choose “Plead with them.” Clear Abandoned Tomb. After its boss, take the key back to the sealed wall near the entrance, unlock it and open the chest for Malveno's Ring; beating the boss alone does not give the ring. Collect the Gold Beetle before returning.

steps.label: Checkpoint
steps.text: Eloquence 3 is the source's target after this reading. Keep training and reporting More's tasks during dungeon visits. His Imagination rewards support the later Strohl request.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon.

steps.label: Free hand-in · Martira
steps.text: Go to Thoroughfare Square → Visca Alba Tavern. Give one Benevolent Bread to the Classy Woman inside, near the guest-room door, to complete The Queen of Cuisine: Heart.
items: If you could not cook the bread on 13 July, keep the request active and continue today's schedule. It has no deadline; bring her a serving after you make it on a later trip.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Return Malveno's Ring to the Pompous Man in Martira's Thoroughfare Square for A Dagger, a Ring, and a Rake. Complete the associated introductory event and confirm Alonzo rank 1.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Heismay through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 4.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Strohl through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 5; accept A Noble's Legacy.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Debate Loveless at Stairstone Market. Choose “Alcohol won't bring equality.” Record the win.

steps.label: Before the story moves on
steps.text: Confirm the three Martira debate wins and the town's dated requests are complete.

steps.label: Ingredient check
steps.text: Keep these supplies for today's roast and tomorrow's meatballs.
items: Curative Coney Roast: 1 Mora Coney Meat + 1 Orgo Sugar + 2 Pristine Clearwater.
Critical Meatballs: 1 Giant Worm Meat from the castle + 1 Rockbeans + 1 Redgrass.
Missing an ingredient only delays that dish. Continue the reading and bond activities on their scheduled dates.

steps.label: Afternoon · cook, then read
steps.text: During the story journey, use the runner's kitchen before starting your book.
items: Cook Curative Coney Roast: 1 Mora Coney Meat + 1 Orgo Sugar + 2 Pristine Clearwater. If an ingredient is missing, leave the recipe unfinished.
Then begin Bygone Days.

steps.label: Night · cook, then talk
steps.text: Collect the glowing campfire ingredient before your main activity.
items: Cook Coney Stew only if you have 1 Mora Coney Meat, 2 Briny Salt and 2 Mellow Milk.
If you lack the salt, skip the stew tonight and keep its meat and milk. The guide returns to this recipe on 29 July, after you can buy salt in Brilehaven.
Then take a party conversation that raises Imagination.

steps.label: Checkpoint
steps.text: Aim for Imagination 3 before completing Strohl's request on 23 July. Report More's 15-Archetype task as soon as eligible. A missing cooking ingredient can wait for another travel slot; the reading and virtue activity take priority.

steps.label: Afternoon · cook, then read
steps.text: Use the runner's kitchen before your book.
items: Cook Critical Meatballs: 1 Giant Worm Meat + 1 Rockbeans + 1 Redgrass. If anything is missing, leave the recipe unfinished and keep the remaining ingredients.
Read Bygone Days for the second time and receive the route drawing.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Finish Bygone Days. Keep gathering pantry and campfire ingredients.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Reread Bygone Days for Tolerance.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Reread Bygone Days again. Repeated readings still give the base virtue reward, but only the first completion counts toward the book collection.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Follow the required travel encounter and confirm Catherina rank 3 by the time this journey ends.

steps.label: Free exploration · Brilehaven
steps.text: Walk around and enter the available shops. Buy upgrades only within your budget. Find the inn when you have completed the free exploration.

steps.label: Gold Beetle · Seabreeze Street
steps.text: Search the northwest part of the eastern back alleys, near the crates.

steps.label: Gold Beetle · Seabreeze Street
steps.text: Search the northeastern corner of the western dock area, behind/below the ramp.

steps.label: Gold Beetle · Merchants' Bazaar
steps.text: Check the northwest edge of the southern group of stalls.

steps.label: Gold Beetle · Merchants' Bazaar
steps.text: Search the southwest corner of the outdoor courtyard outside the Recruitment Centre.

steps.label: Gold Beetle · Arenafront Wharf
steps.text: Check the northeastern edge of the wharf near the wall/crates.

steps.label: Free introduction · Arenafront Wharf
steps.text: Speak to the Gold Beetle collector to activate his collection. This schedule holds beetles until your inventory reaches 46, then completes the exchanges together. If you already exchanged some, note the rewards you claimed; a lower held count does not mean those beetles were lost.

steps.label: Optional shopping
steps.text: Inspect the accessory seller's stock in Merchants' Bazaar. It changes with the weekday. Follow the story after finding the inn.

steps.label: Story day
steps.text: Follow the main objective. No separate free-time activity is scheduled; continue until the game advances the date.

steps.label: Optional
steps.text: The accessory seller has the Archetypal Ring on Watersdays, including today. An A-EXP accessory can reduce training time. Buying seven is optional; the protagonist is the character who must master all available Archetypes for the trophy.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Keep enough MAG for studies rather than converting it all to reeve. Follow the story.

steps.label: Free priority · Angler's Inn Square
steps.text: Speak to Julian beside the fountain and obtain The Magical Future. Check the runner bookshelf afterwards. This is a book pickup, not today's reading activity; collect it during this stay.

steps.label: Free request · Angler's Inn Square
steps.text: Speak to the Exhausted Woman northwest of Spider's Den Inn, beside the Watchtower, and accept Soldier's Solace. Its berries are collected on the planned Gracia Forest trip.

steps.label: Free request · Angler's Inn Square
steps.text: Speak to the Overfamiliar Man outside the Nightprowler weapon shop and accept Deeds and Diversions.

steps.label: Free request · Arenafront Wharf
steps.text: Accept The Chalice vs. The Brew from the Brewer. Give a Medicinal Herb to the Man in Pain here and keep the Tail Bait reward for fishing.

steps.label: Free conversation · Coliseum
steps.text: Enter the Coliseum lobby from Arenafront Wharf and speak to the Pompous Noble for Deeds and Diversions. The deed hand-in comes after the planned tower visit.

steps.label: Free request · Merchants' Bazaar
steps.text: Speak to the Craftsman north of Galeo Swordshop, near the bridge, and accept Superior Scrimshaw.

steps.label: Free requests · Seabreeze Street
steps.text: Accept Efflorescent Youth from the Kindly Boy in the southern area and Dental Distress from the Sullen Man in the western area. The latter needs a village purchase during the next trip.

steps.label: Free preparation · Brilehaven
steps.text: At the Recruitment Centre in Merchants' Bazaar, accept Grieving Ghost of the Goblet, the Fatolich bounty. In Angler's Inn Square, enter The Greatest Catch Tavern and speak to the Seasoned Man, the informant. Buy the reports for your new requests, especially Fiend of the Forsaken Tower. Check the destinations appear on the runner map before 29 July.

steps.label: Free hand-in · Grand Trad and Brilehaven
steps.text: Teleport to Grand Trad and enter St. Fermis Church on Sunlumeo Street. Speak to the Sanctor behind the altar and open the shop's Key Items category. Buy Rainbow Flower for 500 reeve, then return to Seabreeze Street in Brilehaven and give it to the Kindly Boy for Efflorescent Youth. Its deadline is 10 August.

steps.label: Free request steps · Grand Trad
steps.text: With Imagination 3, speak to the Fishmonger on the west side of the Regalith Grand Cathedral market for A Noble's Legacy. Then speak to the Capital Merchant to the northwest, near the water, and choose “Did his fish stink?” These are daytime conversations. Complete them before reporting back to Strohl for his bond event.

steps.label: Optional free collectible check
steps.text: Look around the Grand Trad market stalls and the cow/hay area of Martira's Cattleracket Road. These two beetles' earliest appearance is disputed; meeting the collector is not a verified trigger. If absent, use the 26 September recheck. Do not spend an activity slot trying to force them.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Strohl on Grand Trad's Sunlumeo Street outside Nau Filono Tavern, or use Followers to reach him. Report A Noble's Legacy after the merchant steps above and complete his rank 6 event.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: At the Merchants' Bazaar speech podium in Brilehaven, debate Jin and choose “We should help anyone.” Record the win.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Bardon through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 2.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: At the Merchants' Bazaar podium in Brilehaven, debate Glodell. Choose “You only parrot Louis!” Record the win.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Complete the Charadrius infiltration. Prepare your party and supplies before entering, then follow the key objectives. Where the game offers two alternate key routes, either completes the required path; both are not required for the all-quests trophy.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the main objective.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Bardon through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 3. This opens the General study path once its Archetype prerequisites are met.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: At the Merchants' Bazaar podium in Brilehaven, debate Rudolf. Choose “The tribes must stand together.” Record the win.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Strohl through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 7.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: At the Merchants' Bazaar podium in Brilehaven, debate Milo. Choose “Beauty is deeper than our skin!” Record the win. The source targets Eloquence 4 here.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Maria through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 6.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Enter the Coliseum from Arenafront Wharf in Brilehaven and speak to the Spirited Receptionist. Accept Defeat the Coliseum Monster and beat the certification fight within three rounds. Confirm the request is complete. Later arena dates advance the ranked ladder with this receptionist; the endurance Gauntlet is a separate mode.

steps.label: Before departure
steps.text: Stock up for six days away. Check Soldier's Solace, Superior Scrimshaw, The Chalice vs. The Brew, Dental Distress, Deeds and Diversions, Relic Search: Dregs of Destiny and the Fatolich bounty are active. Buy missing destination reports from the informant inside The Greatest Catch Tavern in Angler's Inn Square.

steps.label: Free shopping · Merchants' Bazaar, Brilehaven
steps.text: Buy enough to reach these inventory totals before departure.
items: Castor Water Shop: 3 Pristine Clearwater and 3 Briny Salt. If you have not cooked Coney Stew yet, hold 5 Briny Salt instead.
The Ruffian's Reel, run by the Fervent Fishmonger: 4 Marbled Bluefin Tuna.
If Coney Stew is unfinished, keep 1 Mora Coney Meat for tonight. Buy a replacement at The Ruffian's Reel if needed.
Keep these supplies for the recipes named on the coming travel days. You will buy milk at today's Inundo stop.

steps.label: Route
steps.text: Inundo, Tomb of Lament, Forsaken Tower, Gracia Forest. Ensure the chosen tower route intersects Catherina's pink runner; you need the next encounter before leaving this region.

steps.label: Afternoon · while travelling
steps.text: Take Hulkenberg's bond event on the runner, reaching rank 6.

steps.label: Village stop · Inundo
steps.text: Use the shop menu when the runner arrives.
items: Under Key Items, buy Toothbrush of Hygienia for 500 reeve. Keep it for the Dental Distress hand-in on 05 August, before the 09 August deadline.
Buy enough Mellow Milk to hold 3. If Coney Stew is still unfinished, top up to 5 instead: 2 for tonight's stew and 3 to keep for later recipes.
Continue toward Tomb of Lament.

steps.label: Night · catch up on Coney Stew, then bond
steps.text: Check whether you have already cooked this recipe.
items: If unfinished, cook Coney Stew now: 1 Mora Coney Meat + 2 Briny Salt + 2 Mellow Milk. If already cooked, skip this cooking session.
Then take Heismay's travelling bond event, finishing at rank 5.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Read The Magical Future, first session; choose ‘It won't work for everyone’. Receive the route drawing. Clear Tomb of Lament for Fatolich and the relic, and find both Gold Beetles. Check for two Giant's Ribs from the giant enemies for two separate recipes; if you leave with fewer, record which dishes must wait for later supplies.

steps.label: After the dungeon
steps.text: When choosing what to do next, camp here and select onward travel for tomorrow. Do not select the return-to-town route; the next several dates assume you remain on this trip.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Report the relic to Neuras, target rank 3.

steps.label: Training checkpoint
steps.text: Commander rank 20 opens General with Bardon rank 3; More then needs General rank 15. Samurai has its own study prerequisites. A bond unlock does not automatically grant or level an Archetype.

steps.label: Training tip
steps.text: A mastered Archetype still earns useful A-EXP. Each further 1,000 A-EXP produces an item worth 1,000 A-EXP that you can apply to another studied Archetype. Keep a strong combat setup when it helps rather than equipping an unsuitable class just to avoid wasting experience.

steps.label: Route
steps.text: Continue toward Forsaken Tower via Stillwood Camp. Before confirming the route, check that its path crosses Catherina's pink runner. Complete the encounter when it appears so her travelling bond reaches rank 4 on this trip.

steps.label: Afternoon · free cooking
steps.text: In the runner kitchen, make Steadfast Stew before reading.
items: Giant's Rib ×1.
Briny Salt ×1.
Pristine Clearwater ×3.
Missing the rib? Note that Steadfast Stew is still unfinished and continue to today's reading. You can buy a replacement on the island later; you do not need to interrupt this trip to farm one.

steps.label: Afternoon · main activity
steps.text: Read The Magical Future, second session; choose “Immediately is too rash.”

steps.label: Night · free cooking
steps.text: In the runner kitchen, make Precision Fermented Ribs before reading.
items: Fiendflower Nectar ×1.
Giant's Rib ×1. This is a second rib; the afternoon stew used its own.
Marbled Bluefin Tuna ×2.

Missing an ingredient? Note that Precision Fermented Ribs is still unfinished and continue reading. Keep the ingredients you have. The guide checks supplies on 21 August and offers another cooking slot on 25 August.

steps.label: Night · main activity
steps.text: Finish The Magical Future; choose “We have to live and fight on.” Check Wisdom 3.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Reread Bygone Days. Complete the Catherina runner encounter en route if it has not happened yet; confirm rank 4. Clear Forsaken Tower for Orgas and collect its Gold Beetle.

steps.label: After the dungeon
steps.text: Camp and continue onward tomorrow.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Reread Bygone Days.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Travel toward Gracia Forest and reread Bygone Days.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Reread Bygone Days again. Check Tolerance 4 before Maria's next rank. If short, use the 04 August travel reading for Bygone Days as well; record one deferred Wisdom reading for a later travel slot.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Normally reread The Magical Future. If Tolerance remains below 4, use Bygone Days as described yesterday. In Gracia Forest, collect all seven marked Dragonthistle Berries and finish the encounter triggered after the last one. Collect the Gold Beetle before leaving.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon. Return and rest.

steps.label: Free hand-ins · Brilehaven
steps.text: Give the Dragonthistle Berries to the Soldier's Solace requester in Angler's Inn Square. Claim the Fatolich bounty at the Recruitment Centre, then give the chalice to the Brewer at Arenafront Wharf for The Chalice vs. The Brew.

steps.label: Free hand-ins · Brilehaven
steps.text: Give the tower reward to the Superior Scrimshaw Craftsman in Merchants' Bazaar. Give the Toothbrush of Hygienia to the Dental Distress requester on Seabreeze Street and collect the Gold Beetle reward.

steps.label: Free request completion · arena
steps.text: After clearing Forsaken Tower, return to the Pompous Noble at the arena. Discuss real fights and the Forsaken Tower, then ask for the deed. Return the deed to the Overfamiliar Man at Nightprowler for Deeds and Diversions.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Meet Maria at the Hushed Honeybee Inn in Grand Trad. Show your drawings when prompted and take her rank 7 bond event. Check Tolerance 4 before starting; if short, record this event as delayed and raise Tolerance.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: In Martira → Thoroughfare Square, return to the Spirited Youth at the wooden ledge on the northwestern side. After two successful jumps, he offers the super-fine rope for 500 reeve. This third challenge needs Courage rank 3. Save before paying, complete it, and check that At Your Own Risk unlocks. If it fails, reload before retrying. A 250- or 375-reeve offer means you still have an earlier challenge to clear; complete the offered challenge and use a later free evening for the next one. Each visit uses an evening.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Bardon through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 4.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Heismay through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 6.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Maria through Followers and take her next bond event. If rank 7 was completed on 05 August, finish rank 8 now. If rank 7 was delayed, check Tolerance 4 and do rank 7 today; reserve 11 August afternoon for rank 8 and move that arena match to an October recovery slot.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Brigitta through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 5; check Courage 3.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Bardon through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 5; check Eloquence 3.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Check Wisdom 3, then find Alonzo through Followers and take his rank 2 event in Brilehaven's Angler's Inn Square. If Wisdom is short, improve it first and record this bond as delayed; rank 3 needs this event completed.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Strohl through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 8.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Go to Grand Trad → Sunlumeo Street → outside Lycaon Magic Association. Speak to the Watchman at Brigitta's usual spot and answer “I am” to begin her rank 6 event.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Bardon through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 6; keep the resulting request in your log.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Alonzo through Followers and take his rank 3 event. This assumes rank 2 was completed on 08 August; if that event was delayed, leave the usual intervening day before attempting the next rank.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: If Maria reached rank 7 on 07 August, finish her rank 8 today and record one ranked arena match as delayed. Otherwise go to the Coliseum at Brilehaven's Arenafront Wharf and complete the next ranked match with the Spirited Receptionist. Certification is separate; start or continue the ranked ladder, not an endurance Gauntlet.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Return to the Coliseum at Brilehaven's Arenafront Wharf and complete the next ranked match. Continue your current rank ladder; do not choose an endurance Gauntlet.

steps.label: Buffer
steps.text: If an earlier bond or virtue check is still behind, you can defer one of these matches to October. Record the missing match; its Courage gain may also be delayed, so check the upcoming Courage gates rather than assuming they are met.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Return to the Coliseum at Brilehaven's Arenafront Wharf and complete the next ranked match. Continue your current rank ladder; do not choose an endurance Gauntlet.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Alonzo through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 4; check Tolerance 3.

steps.label: Before departure
steps.text: Confirm Catherina rank 4, all four Brilehaven debate wins and the book from Julian. Check the regional requests are complete. Dental Distress expired on 09 August and Efflorescent Youth on 10 August; today's check cannot recover an expired request.

steps.label: Story day
steps.text: Follow the main objective. No separate free-time activity is scheduled; continue until the game advances the date.

steps.label: Afternoon · free cooking
steps.text: In the runner kitchen, make Cursed Love Ballad before fishing.
items: Rockbeans ×2.
Briny Salt ×2.
Dreameater Moth ×1.
If you have no moth, note that Cursed Love Ballad is still unfinished and go fishing. Campfire bugs are random; you can cook this recipe on a later journey.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Go to the fishing point on the runner's deck and choose Tail Bait. Save beforehand if possible.
items: If the prompt says you feel queasy, choose ‘Think like a fish’.
If it says you are tired, choose ‘Give in to naptime’.
If nothing is biting, choose ‘Thrash and splash’.
You receive one of these prompts, not all three. Check that your catch contains Lord of the Lake ×1 and Queen's Honey Jar ×2. Save the fish for tonight's recipe and keep the honey for later cooking.

steps.label: Night · cook, then conversation
steps.text: Make Secretest of Secrets in the runner kitchen before taking Junah's Imagination conversation.
items: Lord of the Lake ×1, from this afternoon's fishing.
Mellow Milk ×2.
Marbled Bluefin Tuna ×2.
Keep both Queen's Honey Jars for later. This dish uses the fish, not the honey.
If an ingredient is missing, write down Secretest of Secrets and the missing ingredient to cook on a later journey. Take Junah's Imagination conversation either way; that is tonight's main activity.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Begin Top Secret Poetry! Do Not Read!

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Follow the required combat/story.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Choose whichever companion you want for the special free-time event. The accessory choice is optional and does not affect platinum completion.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Take Junah's Imagination conversation.

steps.label: Story day
steps.text: Follow the main objective. No separate free-time activity is scheduled; continue until the game advances the date.

steps.label: Free errands · Virga Island
steps.text: Collect the four beetles and buy the missing ingredients for Finisher Noodles before departing.
items: Find the beetles by the tavern walkway, western raised area, dragon statue and boxes near the runner.
On Sandy Coast, visit Graco Meat Market, the Village Butcher, for Monster Bone ×1.
At Amblyrhy's Water Jug, buy enough Pristine Clearwater to hold 3. Earlier recipes used their own water.
Check that you still have Brocaded Koi ×1 from The Queen of Cuisine: Heart. If you used it, leave the dish for a later journey; you cannot substitute another fish.

steps.label: Afternoon · travel
steps.text: Set Dragon Temple as your destination. Once the runner is moving, cook before reading.
items: In the kitchen, select Finisher Noodles: Brocaded Koi ×1, Monster Bone ×1 and Pristine Clearwater ×3.
If an ingredient is missing, write down Finisher Noodles and what you lack so you can cook it on a later journey.
Main activity: read the poetry book's second session, whether or not you could cook.
On arrival, follow the required first visit. The full Dragon Temple clear is scheduled for 20 August.

steps.label: Free requests · island village
steps.text: Outside the inn, accept Peak Curiosity. Follow the path to the Enthusiastic Woman near the central rock and accept The Price of Hope.

steps.label: Free preparation
steps.text: Buy the island informant's destination reports inside Rooster Inn. Teleport to Grand Trad and accept The Greater One-Eyed Scoundrel, the Psyocropos bounty, from the Recruiter Dispatcher inside the Recruitment Centre in the Regalith Grand Cathedral district. Buy Monster of Scoundrel's Hold from Ardea at the Hushed Honeybee Inn on Sunshade Row. There is no bounty dispatcher on the island. Check both this destination and the one for Peak Curiosity are on your map.

steps.label: Free errands · Grand Trad
steps.text: Buy Parchwater from the Key Items category at Comfort Concoctions. While inside, collect the previously unreachable Gold Beetle in the shop corner. Go to Lycaon Magic Association on Sunlumeo Street and select Listen with the clerk to have the quest Igniter appraised for The Price of Hope.

steps.label: Free hand-ins · island village
steps.text: Give the Parchwater to Edeni at Dragon Statue Plaza for Ancestral Solution, then report the appraisal result to the Enthusiastic Woman for The Price of Hope. These are separate requests; check both objectives before moving on.

steps.label: Free requests · island village
steps.text: Speak to Junah nearby after the Parchwater hand-in and accept Save the Mourning Snakes. Find the Hoarse Fisher-Crone near Rooster Inn and accept A Guiding Gift, due by 30 August. Continue past its requester toward the eastern edge of the area for a Gold Beetle.

steps.label: Optional shopping · Brilehaven
steps.text: The new informant information unlocks the Eugief seller's expanded stock on Seabreeze Street. Buy missing mask materials as needed; the selection changes by weekday. Check Akademeia's experiment menu before buying duplicates.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Go to Brilehaven's Coliseum and complete the next ranked match. Check whether Courage has reached rank 4.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Meet Brigitta for her rank 7 bond event. Courage 4 is required. If blocked, improve Courage and record this event as delayed rather than spending the period on an unrelated chat.

steps.label: Free shopping · Virga Island
steps.text: Restock these cooking ingredients on Sandy Coast before departure. Buy only the shortfall after checking what you hold.
items: Graco Meat Market, the Village Butcher: reach White Peach Turnip ×5. Use one today, two tomorrow, and keep two for a later recipe.
Amblyrhy's Water Jug, the Genial Water Seller: buy Queen's Honey Jar ×1. With the two jars caught on 14 August, you should now hold 3.
Keep the honey for later cooking. If the shop has none or you missed the fishing jars, note how many you lack; later fishing and shopping checks offer another chance.
Check A Guiding Gift is active and finish equipment shopping before leaving.

steps.label: Afternoon · travel and dungeon
steps.text: Set Dragon Temple as your destination. Once the runner is moving, visit the kitchen before reading.
items: Cook Sweeter than Poison... using White Peach Turnip ×1, Gauntlet Shrooms ×1 and Lumibee ×1.
The shroom comes from the pantry; the bug comes from campfire pickups. If either is missing, write down the uncooked dish and what you lack, then continue with today's plan.
Main activity while travelling: finish the poetry book.
On arrival: clear Dragon Temple and collect all three Polar Stones for A Guiding Gift before leaving.

steps.label: Training
steps.text: Report More's General-rank-15 task as soon as you meet it. Then work toward 25 different studied Archetypes and one mastered Elite Archetype. These quest rewards help the coming Imagination check.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon. This is a long dungeon; allow a substantial real-world session.

steps.label: Free hand-in · island village
steps.text: Give the three Polar Stones to the Hoarse Fisher-Crone near Rooster Inn to complete A Guiding Gift before its 30 August deadline.

steps.label: Free request · Eupha
steps.text: Accept The Trial of Malnova, then speak to the nearby Clumsy Boy for a Gold Beetle.

steps.label: Free shopping · Virga Island
steps.text: Buy the missing ingredients for the next three meals. These are inventory targets, including anything you already hold.
items: Graco Meat Market, Sandy Coast: Limp Goldfish ×3. Two go into today's platter; keep one for tomorrow's stew.
Krozelli the Hunter, the Boastful Shopkeeper in Dragon Statue Plaza: Geldust ×1 and Fiendflower Nectar ×1 for tonight's Blackbread.
If Precision Fermented Ribs is still uncooked, keep a separate Fiendflower Nectar ×1 and Giant's Rib ×1 for it. Buy whichever of those two ingredients you lack.

If Steadfast Stew is also unfinished, buy a separate Giant's Rib ×1 for it from Krozelli if needed. You need two ribs if both dishes are unfinished. Keep Briny Salt ×1 and Pristine Clearwater ×3 for the stew.
Check that you still have Fragrant Spice ×3 for Blackbread and Mellow Milk ×1 for tomorrow. You reserved these earlier; do not use them for duplicate meals.

steps.label: Optional free preparation · before departure
steps.text: Speak to Edeni at Dragon Statue Plaza to clear the destination's weather if wanted. His effect lasts three days, covering tomorrow's Land of Ceremony visit. Bad weather removes bonus turn icons from weakness and critical hits; weakness damage still applies. This service will not last through the separate 25–28 August trip.

steps.label: Afternoon · travel
steps.text: Depart from Virga Island toward Land of Ceremony. Once underway, cook before meditating.
items: Make Holistic Whitefish Platter in the kitchen: Limp Goldfish ×2, White Peach Turnip ×2 and Gauntlet Shrooms ×1.
Keep the remaining Limp Goldfish ×1 for tomorrow and White Peach Turnip ×2 for later. If an ingredient is missing, note this recipe and what you lack so you can cook it on a later journey.
Main activity: meditate with Eupha, whether or not you could cook.
Confirm you receive the Prismatic Sea drawing on this route before the later story departure.

steps.label: Night · cook, then conversation
steps.text: Make Stale Blackbread in the runner kitchen before taking Junah's Imagination conversation.
items: Geldust ×1.
Fiendflower Nectar ×1.
Fragrant Spice ×3.
If an ingredient is missing, note Stale Blackbread and what you lack for a later journey. Take Junah's Imagination conversation either way; that is tonight's main activity.

steps.label: Afternoon · cook, then read
steps.text: Check the runner kitchen for the new recipe, then make Almighty Golden Stew before reading.
items: Limp Goldfish ×1.
Mellow Milk ×1.
Lumibee ×1.
If the recipe is unavailable or an ingredient is missing, note Almighty Golden Stew for a later journey.
Main activity: reread The Magical Future, whether or not you could cook.

steps.label: On arrival · dungeon
steps.text: Clear Land of Ceremony, collect its relic and Gold Beetle, and finish The Trial of Malnova to unlock Eupha's bond.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon. Return and rest.

steps.label: Before spending time
steps.text: Visit More and report tasks you have actually completed. Check Wisdom and Imagination against tomorrow's rank-4 requirements. Later More tasks may still depend on follower unlocks; do not assume they can all be handed in today to supply the missing virtue.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Go to Virga Island's Sandy Coast and use the beach-view Wisdom activity. If Wisdom is already 4 and Imagination is short, use an available Imagination activity instead.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: At the Hushed Honeybee Inn in Grand Trad's Sunshade Row, speak to Fabienne while Maria is present and choose the help option, “Let's do it, then”. Do not select the named Redgrass-Roasted Bidou dish. Follow the prompt for the dish she gives you and confirm Chef in Training afterwards. Maria needs at least rank 2; this event must be done before October.

steps.label: Recovery rule
steps.text: Keep this trophy night. If a virtue is still short, use tomorrow's blocked bond slot to improve it. Do not follow advice to earn the trophy and reload unless you intentionally want to undo that activity on your save.

steps.label: Before either activity
steps.text: Report any completed More task, but check its actual requirements. General rank 15, 25 different studied Archetypes and one Elite Archetype at rank 20 are separate turn-ins. Later studies can require follower unlocks you do not yet have. If a virtue remains short, take the stated virtue activity and record the town bond for the 02 October recovery branch.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Hulkenberg through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 7, only with Wisdom 4. If blocked, use another Wisdom activity instead and record Hulkenberg rank 7 as delayed.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Heismay through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 7, only with Imagination 4. If blocked, use an available Imagination activity instead and record the delay.

steps.label: Afternoon · travel and cooking catch-up
steps.text: Set Orbwise Path as your destination. Once the runner is moving, visit the kitchen before meditating.
items: If you skipped Precision Fermented Ribs on 1 August, make it now: Fiendflower Nectar ×1, Giant's Rib ×1 and Marbled Bluefin Tuna ×2.
If you already cooked it, skip this recipe. You may instead make one other unfinished dish if you have its ingredients.
If supplies are still missing, note what you lack and continue to today's meditation below. Speed Cooking lets you cook one dish before that activity.

steps.label: Afternoon · main activity
steps.text: On the journey to Orbwise Path, meditate with Eupha and choose the deep-breathing response. On arrival, clear Save the Mourning Snakes and find both Gold Beetles. This unlocks Junah's bond.

steps.label: After the dungeon
steps.text: Choose to camp here, then continue toward Silento and Spire of Blind Faith tomorrow. Do not return to town; the next three dates rely on continuing this journey.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Report the Land of Ceremony relic to Neuras, target rank 4.

steps.label: Cooking catch-up · this journey
steps.text: Use the kitchen to make dishes you had to skip. With Speed Cooking, you can cook once before the daytime activity and once before the night activity.
items: Open the kitchen recipe list and choose an uncooked dish for which you have all ingredients. Start with Magical Bread or Invincible Noodles if either is still unfinished.
Magical Bread needs Mora Coney Meat ×2, Rockbeans ×2 and Dreameater Moth ×1.
Invincible Noodles needs Fragrant Spice ×1, Bidou Meat ×2 and Lumibee ×1.
At night, inspect the glowing campfire pickup before cooking. The bug is random; if you get neither bug you need, keep the scheduled conversation below.
More dishes still uncooked? Keep their names and missing ingredients on your notes list for the next journey. Do not replace today's meditation or conversation with extra cooking.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Continue the journey, meditate with Eupha and choose the response about focusing on numbness. At Silento, open the village shop before continuing. Merely passing its map marker is not the intended shop visit.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Take Junah's Imagination conversation. If you deferred a Wisdom reading and Imagination is already sufficient, this is a possible catch-up slot; check that tomorrow's rank events are eligible before swapping.

steps.label: Afternoon · travel
steps.text: If Hulkenberg's town rank 7 is complete, take her travelling rank-8 event. If rank 7 was delayed, it cannot be done on the runner: use a Wisdom reading or another eligible activity instead, and keep the town event pending for 02 October. Receive the Sporico Cave route drawing.

steps.label: Night · travel
steps.text: If Heismay's town rank 7 is complete, take his travelling rank-8 event. If rank 7 was delayed, use an Imagination activity or unfinished book; keep the town event pending for 02 October.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Record town rank 7 and travelling rank 8 separately if either bond is unfinished. The planned recovery uses the 02 October town periods, followed by 06 October travel: Hulkenberg in the afternoon and Heismay at night. It requires the relevant virtues to be ready by then.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Reread The Magical Future, then enter Spire of Blind Faith. Speak to the Confident Woman at the entrance for Peak Curiosity. Clear the tower and collect its Gold Beetle. After defeating Leogron, take the Monster Notebook back to the Confident Woman at the entrance before leaving for town. Tomorrow's village hand-in depends on this conversation.

steps.label: Preparation
steps.text: The source suggests grinding to level 57 for a coming optional bond battle. That number is not an entry requirement. Improve your build, healing and defences as needed; you can postpone the difficult bond fight instead.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Used by the dungeon. Return and rest.

steps.label: Free hand-in · Virga Island
steps.text: Speak to the Dejected Man outside Rooster Inn to complete Peak Curiosity. Yesterday's Monster Notebook must already have been given to the Confident Woman at the spire entrance. Optional discounted shopping and MAG exchange can follow; keep a reserve for Archetype studies.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Eupha through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 2.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Alonzo through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 5.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Save before Bardon's rank 7 event, which includes a strong boss. Complete The Right to Rule if your team can handle it. Otherwise postpone this event to the free October days; do not force a large grind merely to match this date.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Junah through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 2.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Eupha through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 3.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Return to the Coliseum at Brilehaven's Arenafront Wharf and complete the next ranked match. Continue your current rank ladder; do not choose an endurance Gauntlet.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Alonzo through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 6.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Junah through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 3.

steps.label: Afternoon · uses time
steps.text: Find Eupha through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 4.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Return to the Coliseum at Brilehaven's Arenafront Wharf and complete the next ranked match. Continue your current rank ladder; do not choose an endurance Gauntlet. Check Courage 5 before the later Alonzo gate. If you moved arena sessions, their Courage rewards must still be earned.

steps.label: Before departure · free errand · Sandy Coast, Virga Island
steps.text: Find the Hearty Shopkeep beside the Village Butcher on the bridge. Pay 250 reeve and try the local food challenge for Tail Bait if you have not already collected that reward. Keep the bait for 07 September.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Set a route toward Inundo that intercepts Jin's runner; check its marker and your active party before leaving. Meditate with Eupha. If this is your fourth meditation, after 21, 25 and 26 August, choose ‘A burning fire.’ Complete the runner encounter and return to town for tonight's bond.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Find Junah through Followers and take the bond event, finishing at rank 4.

steps.label: Free shopping first · Dragon Statue Plaza, Virga Island
steps.text: Visit Krozelli Hunter, the Boastful Shopkeeper, for missing talismans. Compare stock with Akademeia's Special Experiments list and your budget; purchasing materials is not the same as making the vessels. Afternoon · uses time: Take Eupha's bond event to rank 5.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Story.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Follow the story. Choose whichever companion you prefer for the evening event. Its equipment reward is optional; no repeated runs are needed to collect every version for the platinum.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: If still needed, use the quiet inn opportunity to work toward 100 conversations with Gallica.

steps.label: Afternoon · fishing · uses time
steps.text: Go to the fishing point on the runner's deck and select Tail Bait. Match your answer to Heismay's comment:
items: Queasy: choose “Think like a fish”. Tired: choose “Give in to naptime”. Nothing biting: choose “Thrash and splash”.
Check that you receive 1 Lord of the Lake and 2 Queen's Honey Jars.
Keep this fish for Enchanted Pottage and the honey for cooking.

steps.label: Night · uses time
steps.text: Speak to Eupha in the runner's lounge and reminisce for Imagination.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Begin How to Walk Outside the Island. Receive the route drawing.

steps.label: Night
steps.text: Read its second session.

steps.label: Afternoon
steps.text: Finish How to Walk Outside the Island. Check Tolerance 5. Receive the next route drawing.

steps.label: Evening · free collection · Altabury
steps.text: Find five Gold Beetles: Lunlumo Approach's southeast pavement by a tree; down the stairs in the northeast of Lunlumo Approach; the pot inside Whitepeaks Magic Shop on Lower Blue Sky Bridge, open at night; behind a pillar between Cielaroko Armsmith and Snowflower Pharmacy on Upper Blue Sky Bridge; and the northeast end of the Opera House Square bridge, near the guard. Then find Skyward Tavern, the inn on Dia Franco Street.

steps.label: Before the required destination
steps.text: Collect the Gold Beetle behind barrels in Skyward Tavern and do any available shopping.

steps.label: To do
steps.text: Follow the Opera House objective and story. Do not assume an extra toilet visit or free activity is possible today.

steps.label: Story day
steps.text: Follow the main objective. No separate free-time activity is scheduled; continue until the game advances the date.

steps.label: Story day
steps.text: Follow the main objective. No separate free-time activity is scheduled; continue until the game advances the date.

steps.label: Keep a start-of-day save
steps.text: Today's debate and short trip share a tight schedule. Read this day's instructions before committing to travel.

steps.label: Free conversations · Dia Franco Street, Altabury
steps.text: Speak to Loveless and Rudolf outside Skyward Tavern so their runners appear on the map.

steps.label: Free requests · Altabury
steps.text: Accept Warmth in Winter from the man outside the inn. Accept Proof of Power from the soldier near the arrival point in Opera House Square.

steps.label: Free preparation
steps.text: Accept the Icebeast Chimenzahn bounty at the Recruitment Centre. Buy the Tower of Insolence report from the informant to reveal that destination. On Lower Blue Sky Bridge, give a Medicinal Herb to the Man in Pain and keep the Tail Bait.

steps.label: Before departure · free shopping
steps.text: Buy only what you need to reach the quantities below. These are amounts to have in your inventory, not extra amounts to buy.
items: Altabury → Upper Dia Franco Street → Dedicated Butcher / Korno Meat Market: have 1 Brocaded Koi and 2 Monster Bones.
On the same street, visit Aurelia Water Shop: have 2 Orgo Sugar.

If Finisher Noodles is still unfinished, increase your targets at Korno Meat Market to 2 Brocaded Koi and 3 Monster Bones. Also buy enough Pristine Clearwater at Aurelia Water Shop to hold 3. The extra fish, bone and water are for those noodles.
Grand Trad → Regalith Grand Cathedral market → Herb-Seller: have 3 Redgrass.
Virga Island → Sandy Coast → Village Butcher / Graco Meat Market: have 2 White Peach Turnips. Use town-to-town fast travel for these shopping stops, then return to Altabury.
Check your rare ingredients: 1 Lord of the Lake, 5 Queen's Honey Jars and 2 Lumibees. The five honey cover today's stew, a later cake and the final recipe.

If short on honey, check Amblyrhy's Water Jug on Virga Island's Sandy Coast for remaining stock. If a rare ingredient is still missing, continue today's trip and bond; leave the affected recipe for a later journey.

steps.label: Afternoon · route
steps.text: Set out toward Malva on a route that meets Loveless' runner. Check the encounter marker before confirming the route.

steps.label: While travelling · cooking, then bond
steps.text: Visit the runner's kitchen before choosing Basilio's bond event.
items: Cook Amber Stew with 1 Brocaded Koi, 1 Queen's Honey Jar and 3 Redgrass. Speed Cooking leaves your main activity available.
If an ingredient is missing, skip this dish for now. Keep today's bond event.
Take Basilio's first bond event on the runner, then complete the Loveless encounter on the route.

steps.label: Village stop · Malva
steps.text: Open the village shop before returning to Altabury.
items: Buy Durable Spider Silk for Warmth in Winter.
Buy enough Altabury Wheat Flour to hold 4: 1 for tomorrow's pottage, 2 for Indestructible Honey Cake on 17 September and 1 for Adamantine Honey Cake on 18 September.
Return to Altabury.

steps.label: Night · free hand-in
steps.text: Give the Durable Spider Silk to the Warmth in Winter requester outside the inn. Speak to Loveless there to accept Defeat Milo, then find Milo near the Recruitment Centre to put his runner on the map.

steps.label: Night · uses time, priority
